story.paragraph1: I started my career in 2013 at S-cubism Inc., developing and maintaining e-commerce sites as a programmer. Over time I moved into project leader and project manager roles, working across the whole development process from requirements onward.
story.paragraph2: In 2015 I joined Leprechaun Inc., maintaining e-commerce sites as a project manager and building them as a frontend engineer. In 2017 I joined YUMEMI Inc., where I worked on new development, maintenance and enhancement of APIs and web applications.
story.paragraph3: 2020 was a big year. In March I became a board director at YUMEMI and, the same month, started podcasting. In July I published my book, "Riot.jsで簡単Webアプリ開発". From 2022 I served as an executive officer.
story.paragraph4: In 2024 I joined Kaminashi Inc. As an engineering manager I worked on evaluation and productivity for the product team behind "Kaminashi Employee", and later moved to Engineering HR, working on tech branding and recruitment marketing. In November 2026 I joined OpenProp Inc. as an Engineering Manager.
story.paragraph5: Outside of work, I am a father of one. Between work, podcasting and parenting, I also enjoy drawing generative art with code using p5.js (my works are on OpenProcessing).

concept.title: Concept
concept.description1: 'Amayadori to WEB no Kobanashi.fm' is a podcast where you take a break from the daily rain of information and listen to small web tales under the eaves.
concept.description2: From frontend-focused web technology topics to daily insights and creative discussions, we deliver content you can enjoy in a relaxed atmosphere.

story.title: Why 'Amayadori' (Taking Shelter from Rain)?
story.description1: The title 'Amayadori' (Taking Shelter from Rain) carries a special meaning. The web industry is flooded with information. New technologies and tools emerge one after another, and it can be exhausting just to keep up.
story.description2: In this show, we take a step back from the rain of information and share small stories about the 'history' and 'behind-the-scenes' of technology. A place where you can pause and listen at your own pace. That's what 'Amayadori to WEB no Kobanashi' is all about.
